pages.title: High-Energy Particle Turret
pages.text: $(br2)A large turret that fires physical high-energy particle projectiles.$(br2)Functions only on a subspace and consumes Particle Containers as ammunition.

Supports selectable targeting modes; hostile-subspace mode requires a linked Control Seat.$(br2)Effective against slow-moving entities and hostile subspaces, but less accurate against fast-moving targets.$(br2)Maximum targeting distance/range: 256 blocks.
